messages:
Maya Singh: quick sync — we need to finalize the "connector certification" bar for secrets manager / HSM partners this week. two asks: commercial split + test-suite requirements. can we land a decision by Fri?
Oscar Ruiz: yes. marketplaces team also wants a simple tiered incentive (revenue share + co-marketing credits). prefer something predictable for partners.
Priya Nair: from security: mandatory items are crypto attestation, offline key-wrap test, and audit log forwarding. also need an automated SCIM provisioning run book.
Jonas Weber: SI partners will want a faster onboarding lane for smaller pilots. suggest a "pilot" badge that short-circuits some enterprise paperwork but still requires the test harness pass.
Maya Singh: good call. proposal from GTM: three tiers — Pilot, Certified, and Enterprise-Ready. suggested economics: Pilot = 85/15 referral split + $5k co-marketing credit; Certified = 75/25 + $15k; Enterprise-Ready = 65/35 + joint pipeline credit (negotiated). open to feedback.
Oscar Ruiz: +1 to the tiers, but recommend reducing the Pilot credit to avoid abuse. maybe $2k. also add an SLA uplift bonus for partners that pass perf targets.
Priya Nair: technical gating checklist (automated tests preferred):
```
- SSO (SAML/OIDC) integration test (login & group sync)
- SCIM provisioning: create/update/deprovision cycle
- Key-wrap interoperability: AES-KW / RSA-OAEP vectors
- Secrets rotation + versioning test
- Audit log streaming (syslog/HTTPS) + sample retention proof
- Latency profile: 95th percentile < 120ms for key-wrap ops in sandbox
- Crypto attestation doc + signing cert chain verified
```
Maya Singh: can we make the latency target configurable per tier? Pilot: 250ms, Certified: 120ms, Enterprise: 80ms.
Priya Nair: yes, that's reasonable. we'll include perf benchmarks in the certification report.
Jonas Weber: onboarding flow question — can partners self-provision the sandbox or do we gate with an invite? self-provision would speed pilots.
Maya Singh: prefer self-provision with rate-limited keys and a usage cap. security to sign off on the sandbox templates.
Priya Nair: we'll provide a sandbox deployment script + API keys with scoped permissions. will also publish example curl tests and a postman collection.
Oscar Ruiz: commercial ops note — need a short partner-facing page that outlines tiers, checklist, expected timeline (2-4 weeks Pilot, 6-8 weeks Certified), and the application form. I'll draft.
Maya Singh: timeline: draft partner page by Wed, security appendix + test vectors by Thu, internal sign-off Fri EOD. public partner preview next Tue.
infra-bot: created PR #512: partners/marketplace/connectors/certification-playbook.md — https://git.redwood.co/pr/512
Oscar Ruiz: linking PR here. I'll add the revenue matrix and co-marketing examples.
Priya Nair: I'll push a security appendix to that PR with test vector files and the automated test harness (pytest).
Jonas Weber: remind legal about the embargo window for joint announcements. recommend minimum 48hr notice.
Maya Singh: noted — legal looped. also adding a checkbox for 'embargo agreed' in the partner tracker.
Oscar Ruiz: one more: telemetry — partners must surface an error metric and average latency in the sandbox report. we'll use that for the SLA uplift bonus.
Priya Nair: agreed. we'll standardize the telemetry schema and publish a sample dashboard JSON.
Maya Singh: thanks all. action items: Oscar to draft public page + revenue table; Priya to add security appendix + test harness; Jonas to coordinate SI pilot invites; Maya to consolidate and schedule partner preview. target publish next Tue if no blockers. :rocket:
